description: A joint academic-industrial consortium in Germany and the Netherlands achieves a breakthrough in energy-efficient inference using photonic chips, demonstrating a prototype that reduces power consumption by 40% compared to state-of-the-art GPU clusters. The design is open-sourced, triggering interest from public-sector AI operators across Europe seeking to reduce dependence on foreign hardware. While not yet scalable, it becomes a focal point for new investment proposals and shifts the discourse around sustainable AI sovereignty.
